sources.excerpt: Jul 5, 2023 · Octopuses Have Three Hearts and Blue Blood Octopuses have THREE hearts

reasoning: Octopuses possess three hearts and blue blood, which is a well-established biological fact. They have two branchial hearts that pump oxygen-depleted blood to their gills, and one systemic heart that pumps oxygen-rich blood throughout the rest of their body. Their blood is blue because they utilize hemocyanin, a copper-rich protein, to transport oxygen (unlike the iron-based hemoglobin found in humans). When oxygenated, hemocyanin turns blue; when deoxygenated, it becomes colorless.
